SystemVerilog signals and integer-bit requirements

Start with the 10 important variables below. All 486 individual quantities are retained in the expandable sections. 436 tested currents, starting at 1 pA.

QI.F: I includes the sign bit; I + F equals the word width. The Q label is the existing signal format; for quantities without a direct RTL register it is the C profile format. Blue curves show the minimum integer bits observed during a valid complete run; orange dashed lines show existing capacity. Red markers identify failed runs, whose ranges are omitted.

Measurement and RTL-mapping notes

These are saved C-model measurements mapped to the current RTL names, not new RTL measurements. Equivalent expressions, shared arithmetic sites, precomputed operations and C-only prefix sums are labelled explicitly. A prefix sum in C does not prove the same range for every node in the RTL adder tree. Wide-product Q formats describe operand scaling.

Blue: integer bits needed. Dashed orange: existing capacity. Select a current to update every reading; hover for a tested point. Each important panel covers all three neurons.
